Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate" /> a [[human]] [[merchant]]<ref name="SC 101" /> '''crewman'''<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> with [[Color|light]] skin and [[Color|graying]] [[hair]] was among a [[Unidentified bulk freighter (New Republic Era)|bulk freighter]]'s personnel. Although protected by [[New Republic]] decree, the [[freighter]] was [[Silvo's pirate raid|attacked]] by a hostile [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]]. In order to repel the invasion, the crewman took<ref name="SC 101" /> his<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> position right by the pirates' entryway and shot an [[Unidentified Ishi Tib pirate (Silvo's pirates)|Ishi Tib individual]] right in the [[eye]], only to be [[Blaster|gunned]] down moments later by the very same individual he had tried to prevent from boarding.<ref name="SC 101" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[human]] [[merchant]] first appeared in the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', making his debut in the pilot episode of the series, "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]],"<ref name="SC 101" /> which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref>{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
